Greek.reason: refers to Greek characters shown in the distance matrix illustration, with no experimental work on Greek language

Hebrew.reason: refers to Hebrew characters shown in the distance matrix illustration, with no experimental work on Hebrew language

Arabic.reason: refers to Arabic characters shown in the distance matrix illustration, with no experimental work on Arabic language

Latin.reason: refers to Latin characters in the distance matrix and to Latin documents (~39% of the corpus) used in experiments, so Latin is actively used in the study

Czech.reason: refers to a small number of Czech manuscripts present in the corpus, but no specific work or evaluation on Czech

Hungarian.reason: refers to a small number of Hungarian manuscripts present in the corpus, but no specific work or evaluation on Hungarian

German.reason: refers to German documents (~60% of the corpus) used in the experiments, so German is actively used in the study

Italian.reason: refers to a parallel corpus of Italian medieval abbreviations that the authors provide, indicating collection and use of Italian data

English.reason: refers to a Shakespeare experiment on Elizabethan English used to evaluate de-mapping, so English is actively used in the study
